bounded_slice: Verify the current sole ACTIVE_WAVE/index/feed coordinator state as one integrity chain: read the current ACTIVE_WAVE and linked index/feed state, verify scope/provenance and zero-Work/zero-finite-quota/zero-cost Phase-1 gates, and make no semantic mutation unless the chain itself requires an integrity-safe coordinator correction supported by exact current evidence.
write_cas_target: No shared semantic write is pre-authorized by this preflight; any required coordinator correction must refetch current main and exact target blob before mutation. Lifecycle evidence is append-only under automation_control/receipts/integrator/.
preflight_checks: required instruction blobs fetched and stable on repeated read
intended_readback: Exact-read every lifecycle receipt and any coordinator mutation from main; refetch main after any write and fail closed on conflict.
conflict_policy: On target SHA/head mismatch, discard local mutation plan, refetch current authority, persist bounded continuation if safe, and return without retry/backoff in this invocation.
success_continuation: Resume from the exact post-readback ACTIVE_WAVE/index/feed frontier on the next invocation; do not start a second optional leaf in this invocation.
failure_continuation: Refetch the four required instruction controls and current main, then retry only the unresolved integrity chain from its first unverified edge on the next invocation.
